policy: Curated two-catalogue view: The Acorns (high consequence) and The Seedbed (exploration); The Harvest holds internally resolved results. Symbolic stakes, not cash awards.

weekly_focus.cadence: Explore and test ideas on most days; once each weekend, shortlist around five of that week's candidate problems.
weekly_focus.review_principle: Keep around five strongest weekly candidates in the active workshop, not necessarily in The Acorns; promote only after mathematical and prior-art gates.
required_reviews: search known equivalents and alternative terminology
describe significant positive and negative consequences
judge independence from existing research tracks
weekly_focus.promotion_rule: Weekend selection is not main-catalogue promotion. An Acorn requires verified mathematical potential, substantive consequence and a defensible scope.

note: This is a provisional editorial triage that preserves the canonical P001–P035 IDs and current problem paths.
